paper_title: Riding the dark matter wave: Novel limits on general dark photons from LISA Pathfinder
suggested_experiment_name: LISA Pathfinder (relative acceleration, SC-TM auxiliary channels)
coupling_convention: gauge coupling g_{B-L} (dimensionless, = epsilon_{B-L} * e) exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 5
notes: Paper derives new B-L (and B) dark photon dark matter limits from LISA Pathfinder SC-TM auxiliary channel (relative acceleration) data from the April 2016 noise run. World-leading in 4e-19 eV < m < 3e-17 eV, peak sensitivity ~5e-18 eV. No numerical table is provided; data points are reconstructed from the paper's stated formulas (eq. 8, SNR=1 criterion), charge-to-mass ratios (Table 1: Delta(q/M)_{B-L} = 0.018 GeV^-1), the noise ASDs of fig. 2, and the qualitative shape of figs. 3 & 5 -- values are approximate (~factor 2-3 uncertainty). The limit criterion is SNR<=1, not a formal CL, so the 0.95 CL entry is nominal. Paper also constrains gauged B (weaker, ~3 orders of magnitude) and gives rescalings to other gauge groups; only B-L values are emitted.
